claim_boundary: This separates deterministic and llama backend evidence. The llama run is a 3-row smoke-quality sample, not final Task 2 performance evidence.

commands.command: uv run pytest tests/test_backend_evidence_separation.py tests/test_task2_answer_eval_artifact.py tests/test_chat_provenance.py

uv run python -m nlp_term.chat.compare_backends --gold data/gold/task2_answer_eval_gold.json --facts data/gold/task2_fact_gold.json --knowledge data/knowledge_seed.json --output model/metrics/task2_backend_comparison.json --llama-limit 3

uv run python -m nlp_term.validators --metric-claim model/metrics/task2_backend_comparison.json --input data/gold/task2_answer_eval_gold.json --require-dataset-origin task2_gold --require-claim-level qualitative_check
uv run ruff check src tests

diagnostic_summary.backend_separation: deterministic and llama outputs were evaluated in separate artifacts; no deterministic fallback was counted as llama.
diagnostic_summary.deterministic_signal: deterministic answers are grounded enough for many gold facts but expose internal IDs, causing low naturalness heuristic pass rate.
diagnostic_summary.llama_signal: llama ran on 3 gold prompts without fallback and produced natural-looking answers by the current heuristic, but did not expose source URL hints.
diagnostic_summary.risk: A natural answer can omit explicit source hints, while a sourced deterministic answer can sound unnatural. Task 2 needs separate controls for answer style and provenance.
diagnostic_summary.next_action: Diagnose retrieval bottlenecks before expanding answer generation changes.
